fields.Name: C3 -> S4.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.18 (phase 2, dataset C3, criterion S4.1): on C3 (W9-multiclass s42 with the reference pipeline's holdout) a multiclass target ranks on multiclass log loss; what the gate ships scores at most 0.7427, and /predict returns a probability vector over the 3 declared classes, summing to 1, for 3,000 of 3,000 held-out rows. It fails when /predict drops the probabilities class vector (0 of 3,000 rows carry it).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Multiclass log loss is primary on C3 and at most 0.7427; /predict returns a 3-class probability vector for 3,000 of 3,000 rows (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
